definitions.explanation: A particular branch of study, activity, or interest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{分野|ぶんや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦ですか→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: What is your field of specialization?

examples.japanese: ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{分野|ぶんや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}して→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He is active in various fields.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{分野|ぶんや}⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Japan is advanced in this field.

notes:
Refers to a domain, area, or branch of knowledge, activity, or industry. More formal than ⟦{領域|りょういき}→領域：05459_ryouiki⟧ in everyday use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧{分野|ぶんや}: field of specialization
- ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧{分野|ぶんや}: research field
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分野|ぶんや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: in the field of ~
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な{分野|ぶんや}: various fields
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{分野|ぶんや}: new field
- ⟦{未知|みち}→未知：13014_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{分野|ぶんや}: unknown territory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{領域|りょういき}→領域：05459_ryouiki⟧: domain, territory (more abstract, also used for physical areas)
- ⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧: range, scope (emphasis on boundaries)
- ⟦ジャンル→ジャンル：11017_janru⟧: genre (more casual, used for entertainment/media)
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: industry (specifically business sectors)
